description: This file defines the Services_ExchangeRates_Common class with methods for retrieving and caching data files and XML data, including handling HTTP requests and cache management.

classes.name: Services_ExchangeRates_Common
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve and cache data feeds and XML data, handling HTTP requests and cache expiration.

methods.name: retrieveFile
methods.description: Retrieves data from cache or downloads it via HTTP, handling cache expiration and conditional GET requests.

methods.name: retrieveXML
methods.description: Downloads an XML file or retrieves it from cache, returning an XML_Tree object.
